keyPhrases.text: Adrien Brody, in his Broadway debut, strikes a seductively confident and squirrely pose
Tessa Thompson imbues this woman...with as much authenticity as can be mustered
gets fuzzy whenever the spotlight shifts to somebody other than Nick
her character remains an enigma — or worse, the cliché
Lindsey Ferrentino...stumbles as she tries to open the story up
Inconvenient facts are easily dismissed or ignored

reasoning: Mixed-negative review with significantly more criticism than praise. While acknowledging strong performances from Brody and Thompson, the critic finds major structural and narrative problems with the adaptation, criticizing the writing, character development, and dramatic choices. No clear recommendation to see the show.
